goal: Let libbitcoinkernel consumers inspect step-by-step interpreter state during script evaluation
Enables building external script debuggers and analyzers, and improves interpreter test visibility
reviewability: Waiting on author to address open objections before review is worthwhile
agreement: Unaddressed objection: null error pointers trigger an assertion failure when tracing (w0xlt)
Unaddressed objection: oversized scripts fail to emit begin and end trace frames (w0xlt)
Verified with Python bindings and a visualizer tool without issue (elmeriniemela)
Strong concept support for interpreter testing benefits (furszy, w0xlt)

categories.name: kernel
why: P3 because it adds an optional build-time diagnostic feature rather than core validation functionality.
External consumers gain the ability to build debuggers and fine-grained script execution analyzers.
Interpreter tests and fuzzers can inspect intermediate states to detect shadowed unexpected behavior.
